raw_text: Bellingcat Investigation: Manipulated Satellite Imagery Used to Justify Chinese LAC Claims. Bellingcat has confirmed that satellite imagery circulated by Chinese state-affiliated accounts purporting to show Indian military construction violations along the LAC contains digitally manipulated elements. Error level analysis revealed that structures were spliced from other locations into genuine Maxar imagery. The manipulation campaign was designed to create a pretext for PLA forward deployments along the disputed border.
clean_text: Bellingcat confirms LAC satellite imagery digitally manipulated with structures spliced from other locations into Maxar imagery. Campaign designed to create pretext for PLA forward deployments along disputed border.
